# Pierre-Henry Soria

> Pierre-Henry Soria is a product-first senior software engineer, consultant and technology builder with 12 years of experience. He turns product ideas into shipped, correctness-critical software and designs and orchestrates LLM-agent workflows across implementation, testing and review. His sector experience spans health technology, food technology, financial services and enterprise software. His primary market is Wellington, New Zealand. He is open to consulting across New Zealand, Australia and remote teams.

Consulting can begin with a five-business-day Production Risk & Delivery Sprint, followed by larger scoped delivery or embedded senior engineering when justified. Pierre-Henry's role fit also includes Senior or Lead Software Engineer, AI Product Engineer, Agentic Systems Architect, Founding Engineer, Principal Software Engineer, Software Architect and Solution Architect.

Target consulting markets include MedTech, FoodTech and FinTech. The supporting experience is health software used by doctors, patients and pharmacies; food-tech and healthy-food product work; and enterprise automation in regulated financial services.

Public evidence includes enterprise automation in regulated environments and production work at Zambrero, Sine/Honeywell, Updoc and Eyemagnet, alongside a 13-year open-source platform with 11,000+ commits, a programming language and four software-engineering courses with 225,000+ combined enrolments.

## Public technical work

- [ToucanDB](https://github.com/ToucanDB/ToucanDB): A beta embedded local-first vector database for semantic search, retrieval and application memory.
- [pH7Console](https://github.com/EfficientTools/pH7Console): A privacy-first macOS command console with local intelligence and encrypted history.
- [SucceedAI](https://github.com/SucceedAI/macOS-Desktop-App): A private on-device writing assistant for Apple platforms.
